summary.en: Adds PWA sharing for arbitrary files, admin-managed Klipy integration settings, broader AI provider and transcription support, and safer deployment defaults.

description.en: The Plesk extension now presents the Docker prerequisite, setup order, expected installation time and runtime status more clearly.

title.en: PWA share target for arbitrary files

description.en: The browser and PWA share target accepts text, links, and arbitrary files, stores pending payloads locally, and lets users send them in Nebulynk.
Platform administrators can save or clear an encrypted Klipy API key, while the stored platform value takes precedence over the environment fallback.
OpenRouter transcription is supported and AI model selection can be filtered in the administration settings.
The packaged template exposes optional integration and operational settings and documents the transition from HTTP smoke testing to HTTPS production deployment.
The packaged deployment defaults allow up to 30 minutes for meeting transcript processing.

en: Back up PostgreSQL and both Garage volumes and test a restore before updating.
Redeploy the backend and frontend from the shared v0.5.0 release tag without removing persistent volumes; the backend applies migration 069_platform_secrets automatically at startup.
If using Klipy, configure the key under Admin > Platform Settings or retain KLIPY_API_KEY as an environment fallback; the encrypted platform value takes precedence.
For Dokploy, set NEBULYNK_SOURCE_REF to v0.5.0 for a pinned deployment; after replacing generated domains, enable HTTPS, set NODE_ENV=production, and update dependent public URLs before redeploying.
